meta.name: eol-checklist
meta.description: Build a phase-gated EOL checklist sized to the sunset, with a named owner on every item. Use when the decision to retire is made and you need the operational plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定分阶段的产品退役清单,每项落实到人
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正负责某个产品或服务的退役,需要将收尾工作拆解并落实到具体负责人
copy.tagline_en: Create a phase-gated product retirement checklist with an owner for each item.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're managing a product sunset and need a structured operational plan with clear ownership.

howto.what: 装上后,当用户请它为某个将被停用的产品或服务做收尾规划时,它会产出一份分阶段的待办清单;每个条目都写有动作和负责的部门,并按停用规模调整详细程度:小停用清单短,大型停用覆盖更多阶段与领域。
howto.when: 当某产品或服务的停用决定已经做出,且需要把它变成执行计划时触发。

say.text: 帮我们的旧版报表模块生成EOL清单,12月31日停用,约400个账号。
say.note: 你会得到一份按停用规模调整的收尾清单。

say.text: 生成重型清单:硬件停用,有服务合同和8家经销商。
say.note: 你会得到覆盖更多领域和阶段的清单。

say.text: 做个轻量清单:内部小工具停用。
say.note: 你会得到一份很短的清单,只列少数必要动作。

howto.what_en: Produces a phase-gated EOL checklist sized to the sunset; every item has an action verb and a named owning function. Light sunsets get a short punch list; major retirements get the full cross-functional playbook.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the decision to retire a product is made and the user asks for an operational plan. If given no details, it asks up to three questions, then picks a level and builds.

say_en.text: EOL checklist for legacy reporting module, shut down Dec 31, 400 accounts.
say_en.note: You get a retirement checklist sized to the sunset.

say_en.text: Heavy EOL checklist for hardware line with service contracts and resellers.
say_en.note: Covers more areas and phases for a big sunset.

say_en.text: Light EOL checklist for an internal tool deprecation.
say_en.note: Short punch list with only essential items.
